text: Epilogue logbook opens with 'Discovery - Frozen star' toast partly hidden behind the logbook panel (left edge of toast text cut by panel), tick ~42
Mouse wheel (pt scroll 10 over the panel) did not scroll the expedition log; had to drag the scrollbar to reach 'Keep exploring' button, which is below the fold at 1280x720

Comms console: first E gives one Ines line (tidal 0.15 g), then pressing E again (3 tries, ticks ~1600-1900) does nothing at all, while the 'E Use the comms console' prompt stays up. No panel opens, no Postscript offer, no 'nothing more to say' feedback.

Photo mode (P): clear on-panel help, Sky only toggle hides the ship nicely. Save picture shows 'Developing...' then the toast vanishes with no 'Saved' / file name shown in my shots; the PNG did land in ~/Downloads as frozen-star-2026-11-15-20-26-26.png (named in UTC, local time was 13:26). Probe events log photo mode as screen DREAM (WORLD->DREAM at tick 2124).

Chrome 'Page Unresponsive' dialog for Frozen Star appeared while walking from the comms console toward the bay (tick ~2600, facing aft/stores wall). Inputs stopped working (face/walk did nothing). Host load average was ~108 at the time, so likely contention, but the game's main thread blocked long enough for Chrome to flag it.

After ~26 min (ticks 384-3007, host heavily loaded, ~5-8 game ticks/s) no Postscript mission was offered anywhere I reached: the free-roam hint names only 'talk to Ines at the comms console, take the helm, or drop another beacon'; Ines at comms gave two tide lines and nothing else; the objective stays 'Explore the Tern. The lab archive has more.' Could not reach the capsule bay intercom in time.
